Need some tips on how to get your network set up to play AI War? This section is here to help.  Here are the basics:

1. Make sure that both the host and all the clients are using the same network port (you will be by default, unless one of you changed the value.).
2. Make sure that both the clients and the host have allowed AI War access through any software firewalls.
3. When playing on a LAN, that's it!  Either the game will autodetect the host, or can directly type in their local IP (always in the format 192.x.x.x, 172.x.x.x, or 10.x.x.x).
4. When using a VPN client (Hamachi, Commodo, etc), the client will need to type in the VPN IP address of the host (often these are in the format 5.x.x.x).
5. When playing directly over the Internet, the host will need to enable port forwarding on their router in order for the clients to be able to connect via IP.
6. In order for clients to connect directly over the Internet, they will also need the host's public IP address -- this is different from the local IP address, so be careful there.

Here are some good sources for more information about the various subjects above:

This section will help you improve the performance of loading/syncing games across the network, if you are having trouble.  Please note that this will have NO effect on in-game performance, just on game syncs.  The default is N/1200 Messages, with batch network sending not turned off, and this will work well for most people.

However, for those with very fast connections, the old default of 100 Messages, with batch network sending skipped, may provide better performance (these are the old defaults).  This will vary depending on your connection, though, and some people had extremely poor connection speeds even on very fast connections with the old defaults, which is why the new defaults were added.

********     OTHER OPTIONS     ********
- 1 Msg. should generally be avoided, but it might work on some connections.

- If 100 Msgs. gives you some slowdown, but not a lot, try 1000 Msgs.

- N/2400 and N/200 and N/1600 create fewer messagse than N/1200, and may provide better performance than N/1200 on fast-but-not-super connections.

- N/800 and N/400 are really only for very slow broadband connections or lower.

********     IN SUMMARY     ********
The short explanation is that if the new default gives you slowdown, then try the old default.  If that also gives you slowdown, then you can try the other entries here.

********     WHAT SORT OF CONNECTION TIMES TO EXPECT?     ********
Here are some common connection time estimates (which may naturally vary some, but you have problems if it takes more than twice as long as these stated estimates).  Bear in mind that these estimates are for a fullspeed transfer, which might not be achievable because of packet loss and other network conditions, or based on the Network Sync Size you choose.

Host 100kbps upload, 1 Client, 500KB savegame:  41s
Host 100kbps upload, 4 Clients, 500KB savegame:  2m, 44s

Host 100kbps upload, 1 Client, 1.5 MB savegame:  2m, 3s
Host 100kbps upload, 4 Clients, 1.5 MB savegame:  8m, 12s

Host 300kbps upload, 1 Client, 500KB savegame:  14s
Host 300kbps upload, 4 Clients, 500KB savegame:  54s

Host 300kbps upload, 1 Client, 1.5 MB savegame:  42s
Host 300kbps upload, 4 Clients, 1.5 MB savegame:  2m, 47s
中文:
这个设置帮助您改善网络同步性能。请注意这是网络同步性能，与运行速度无关。默认设置为N/1200 信息，并且不跳过分批次网络发送，它适用于大部分人。

不过，对于网络连接速度非常快的人来说，之前版本默认的100 信息，并且跳过分批次网络发送可能会提高速度。这个设置完全依赖于您的网络连接速度，并且对有些网络连接速度非常快的人并不奏效。

********     其他说明     ********
- 1信息。通常不应选取，但可能对一些连接有用。

- 如果100信息减慢了您的速度，但并不太厉害，那么可以尝试使用1000信息。

- N/2400、N/2000、N/1600比N/1200创建更少的信息，可能在网络连接速度较快的机器上比N/1200效果更好。

- N/800、N/400只推荐网络连接速度非常慢的人使用。

********     总结     ********
一言以蔽之，如果默认设置速度不快，那么尝试使用之前版本的默认设置。如果这也不快，那么尝试别的选项。

英文:
Welcome to version 1.201 of the game!  This is a huge new version of the game, and while we're confident you will love it based on the feedback from our month-long public beta of this new version, there are some things you need to know:

1. The economy has had many overhauls to make things simpler in general.  If you were used to the old way, there may be a few mental adjustments you need to make, though.  The Basic Tutorial2, Building Your Economy, has been updated with the new info you need (or you can just figure it out as you go, if you've played a lot of other RTS games).

2. Energy costs are particularly different.  Be careful not to build too many unneeded structures, or you will be perpetually energy-poor.  Also, be sure to take enough planets to support your energy needs.  If you are loading a savegame from a prior version of the game, that's wonderful, but be aware that you may start out with a very negative energy balance.  That is something that can be quickly resolved in most cases by your turning off unneeded structures and adding some new reactors where neccessary.

3. Be aware that energy reactors now have an per-second ongoing metal and crystal cost.  However, to compensate for this, your metal/crystal harvesters no longer have lowered efficiency as you add more of them.  This makes it so that you can expand out pretty well infinitely, but you can't support an infinite amount of ships with too few planets.

4. Aside from the above, there are also a huge number of other enhancements, improvements, and additions to all aspects of the game, including the AI itself.  Please see the release notes if you want to read more about those, but the rest should not be too startling of an adjustment.

Advanced multiplex tractor beam module for Riot Control Starships.  
Can immobilize up to 40 craft at once.
Requires a heavy hardpoint, but cannot be mounted on a MkII.
中文:
防暴星舰上的高级牵引模块.
一次可牵引至多40个敌人.
需要1个重型炮挂点,且不能装配在防暴星舰II型上.

英文:
Crucial for scouting enemy planets and gathering intel data.
Be sure to bring at least one scout with you on every raid, to make sure you can see the full Planetary Summary.
中文:
用于侦察敌人的星球与收集情报.
建议每次行动至少携带一架侦察机,以确保您能看到目标星球的概况.

英文: Very fast ship. Grabs allied ships with less than 100% engine health remaining and brings them to the nearest mobile repair station.
中文: 速度非常快.把引擎机能少于100%的舰艇牵引至最近的机动维修中心.

英文:
Machine gun module for the Riot Control Starship line.
Fires rapidly, has a respectable range, and damages target engines, but loses effectiveness against large targets or heavy shields.
Cannot reduce engines below 50%.
Requires a light hardpoint.
中文:
防暴星舰上的机枪模块.
攻击迅速,拥有不错的攻击范围,并能伤害到目标的引擎.但对付大型目标和重型护盾的效率并不高.
无法将目标的引擎伤害到50%以下.
需要1个轻型炮挂点.

英文: Emits precisely-tuned pulses to drain the health of any enemy ships in the local system.
中文: 发射特定耗损脉冲来攻击星球上的所有敌方部队.

英文: Fast ship able to bypass many standard defenses such as mines and tractor beams.
中文: 高速的战机,能够躲过许多基本防御设施,如空雷和牵引光束.

英文: Fast raiders able to traverse space in an instant.  Terrible against turrets.
中文: 高速的入侵者,可以进行瞬移.不善于对付炮塔.

英文: Makes formation move offsets "sticky" so that a normal move will not clear the offsets (to manually clear offsets, use stop command).
中文: 使您的部队能够保持密集队型而不在移动中散开.

英文:
This is the core from a destroyed command station.  When a player's
home planet command station is destroyed, and that player still has surviving allies, this core warps to the allied home planet.
中文:
这是被摧毁的母星指挥中心的核心.
当一个玩家的母星指挥中心被摧毁,而他拥有仍然生存的盟友时,核心将传送至盟友的母星.

英文: Extremely fast cloaked ship with short-range rapid fire attack.  Becomes significantly stronger when many are at the same planet.
中文: 速度非常快,攻击范围短,攻速快.适合集群作战.

英文:
Advanced alien technology makes this a mobile fortress.
Very strong large groups of ships, and boosts the strength of nearby smaller ships.
中文:
使用先进的外星科技制造的移动要塞.
善于对抗大群敌人,并能提高周围小型舰艇的能力.

英文:
Each command station you control will automatically maintain one Mark I Engineer
at each planet you control.  Building multiple of this control node causes multiple engineers to be maintained at each planet.
Replacement engineers will only be built if there are fewer than 100 mobile enemy ships on the planet.
中文:
每个您控制的指挥中心将自动保持每个星球雄蜂工程师的数量为一个.
建造多个控制指令将使得每个星球上保持的雄蜂工程师的数量为多个.
工程师仅在星球上存在的敌人舰艇数少于100时被重建.

英文: All Attackers Get Damage Bonus Against This x
中文: 得到所有攻击者的奖励 x

英文: Strong fighter in its own right, it also gives a 2x attack bonus to nearby ships on your team.
中文: 战斗力强大的战机,能使附近的友军火力增为原来的2倍.

英文: Generates starships over a long period of time.
中文: 建造强大的星舰,但耗费时间较长.

英文:
Launches flares to dissipate any sniper shots coming within its range.
Particularly useful for setting up 'beachheads' in enemy territory.
中文:
发射照明弹以驱散任何在其范围内的狙击手攻击.
可用来对付敌人的据点.

英文: Control Node: Allow Team Control Of Ships
中文: 控制指令: 允许团队控制部队

英文: Multiple Launcher Rocket System turret fires multiple mid-power rockets.
中文: 发射许多中等威力的火箭进行攻击.

英文:
Very heavily shielded with low speed and range, but a strong attack.
Excellent against heavily defended targets in the same manner as bombers.
中文:
护盾非常强,移动很慢,攻击范围小,但攻击力强.
对重型防御设施造成的伤害如轰炸机造成的一样.

英文:
Repairs damaged ships or can accelerate construction done by other ships.
Unless issued a specific command by its controller, it will automatically repair nearby allies.
Identical to the Mark II engineer, except has more armor, a better repair rate, cloaking, and a larger repair range.
中文:
修复受损的部队,加快其他部队的建造速度.
除非指挥官下命令,否则它会自动修复附近的友军.
性能与工程师II型类似, 但它是隐形的,装甲更厚,维修范围更大.

英文: AI Will Abandon Post To Pursue
中文: 人工智能会舍弃据点追击

英文:
Capturable construction unit that allows human players to build a single type of experimental ship at this one location.
This fabricator allows players to build:
中文:
可占领的工厂,占领后允许您建造某一种试验性部队.
该工厂允许您建造:

英文: Control Node: Engineers To Not Auto-Assist Allies
中文: 控制指令: 工程师不自动协助友军

英文: The command station on this planet  will automatically maintain one Mark I Engineer.  Building multiple of this control node causes multiple engineers to be maintained at this planet. Replacement engineers will only be built if there are fewer than 100 mobile enemy ships on the planet.
中文:
您控制的这个指挥中心将自动保持这个星球雄蜂工程师的数量为一个.
建造多个控制指令将使得这个星球上保持的雄蜂工程师的数量为多个.
工程师仅在星球上存在的敌人舰艇数少于100时被重建.

英文:
Generates a large amount of energy at a great cost-to-benefit ratio.
Efficiency goes down by 40% for each new reactor of this type built on the same planet.
中文:
以较高的成本与效益比,生成大量能量.
同一星球上每多建一个这个类型的反应装置,新的反应装置效率下降40%,效率下降会累积.

英文:
Launches flares to dissipate any dark matter ammo coming within its range.
Particularly useful for protecting against Astro Trains and Munitions Boosters.
中文:
发射照明弹以驱散任何在其范围内的暗物质攻击.
对付星际列车与火力增幅器有很好的效果.

英文:
Armored version of the standard Lightning Warhead.  Almost impossible for enemy ships to destroy, so it is highly likely to reach its target.
Emits a powerful explosion of lightning that damages nearby enemy ships on detonation.
Can be given a direct target that it will chase and then explode near, or it will explode on death.
中文:
闪雷飞弹的强化版本.几乎不可能被摧毁,因此将更有可能到达预期的目标.
发射出一个强大的闪雷并爆炸,能损伤爆炸点附近的所有敌人.
能给予它一个目标,它会追踪目标并引爆,或在途中被摧毁而爆炸.

英文:
Allows you to build economic and defensive ships at planets you don't control.
Cruicial for establishing beachheads in enemy territory, or for helping to reinforce allied planets.
中文:
允许你在未控制的行星制造部队.
可用来对付敌人的据点, 或者增援友军的星球.

英文:
Advanced machine gun module for the Riot Control Starship line.
Fires rapidly, has a respectable range, and damages target engines, but loses effectiveness against large targets or heavy shields.
Cannot reduce engines below 30%.
Requires an advanced light hardpoint.
中文:
防暴星舰上的高级机枪模块.
攻击迅速,拥有不错的攻击范围,并能伤害到目标的引擎.但对付大型目标和重型护盾的效率并不高.
无法将目标的引擎伤害到30%以下.
需要1个高级轻型炮挂点.

英文:
Simultaneously repairs all nearby allied ships.
Also able to build space tugs for reeling in more distant ships that become damaged.
中文:
同时维修附近所有的友军部队.
也可以建造太空拖船来牵引远处的受损友军部队.

英文: Control Node: Auto-Build Engineers Mark III
中文: 控制指令: 自动生产工程师III型
部队建造完成后才扣减所消耗的资源

英文: Server farm.  Destroy to damage AI Progress by 20.
中文: 服务器群.被摧毁时人工智能进度下降20点.

英文: Capture to build Mark IV versions of any ship types in which you have already attained Mark III.  Never destroy these!
中文: 当你拥有前三级的建造技术时可建造第四级别的舰艇.永远不要摧毁它!

英文: Fires low-power lasers at a high rate.  Best in large groups.
中文: 高速地发射低攻击的激光.适合集群作战.

英文: Single Planet Control Node: Auto-Build Engineers Mark III
中文: 单一星球控制指令: 自动生产工程师III型

英文:
Advanced alien technology makes this a lightning-fast death machine.
Extremely strong against large groups of ships, and boosts the strength of nearby smaller ships.
中文:
先进的外星科技让它成为极度恐怖的杀戮机器.
极善于对抗大群敌人,并能提高周围小型舰艇的能力.

英文:
Carries up to 200 units from your Space Docks or Advanced Factories.
Heavily armored and defensible, this is ideal for slipping past minefields, ion cannons, or high-level enemy planets.
If the transport is killed, all of the ships inside are ejected safely just before the explosion.
中文:
从太空兵工厂或高级兵工厂携带至多200个单位.
拥有强大的防御能力,是通过雷区,离子炮和高威胁敌对行星的理想选择.
如果它被摧毁,它里面运输的所有部队将在爆炸前被弹射出来.

英文: Slow, high-power, high-range defense for planetary bases.
中文: 速度慢,威力不俗,能为行星基地提供大范围的防御.

英文:
Electric area-of-effect weapon for the Riot Control Starship MkII.  
Fairly short-ranged, does no engine damage, but can temporarily paralyze large numbers of craft in one burst.  
Can only be mounted on the MkII's heavy hardpoint.
中文:
防暴星舰II型上的电气范围攻击武器.
攻击范围相当小,对引擎无伤害,但一击可瘫痪很多敌人.
只能装配在防暴星舰II型的重型炮挂点上.

英文: Very long range electrical attack.  Protects nearby allied ships by reducing the power of incoming lasers to 1/4 their normal power.
中文: 发射范围非常远的电气攻击.可以保护周围的友军,使攻击他们的激光的火力降为原来的1/4.

英文: Advanced weapon insta-kills most Mark I and II ships (and many ships with no Mark level at all).  Cannot fire upon ships immune to insta-kill.
中文: 可以一击必杀大部分I型和II型部队(和无等级的普通部队).不能对免疫一击必杀的部队开火.

英文: Cloaked.  Stronger, fixed ship reacts with nearby enemy cloaked ships, making them trackable for a short while.
中文: 较强的隐形舰艇.可发现附近的隐形敌舰,使它们在短时间内被追踪.

英文: Allows all teammates to share control of your ships on any planet.
中文: 允许所有盟友在任何星球控制您的部队。

英文:
Fires powerful, long-range missiles, but has a very slow reload time.
Identical to the Missile Frigate Mark II, except 10x more expensive and with no ship cap.
中文:
火力强劲,能发射远程导弹进行攻击,但需要很长的时间来重新装填弹药.
机体性能与导弹巡洋舰II型相同,虽然是原价的十倍,但并没有数量限制.

英文:
Removes exploded enemy ship remains, to prevent them from being rebuilt
by enemy Remains Rebuilders.  Also able to dismantle enemy mines on allied planets.
中文:
清理敌方单位的残骸,防止敌方的残骸重建机重建它们.
也可以发现友军星球上的敌方空雷.

英文: Send to an uninhabited planet to build a new Command Station and capture the planet.
中文: 在一个无人的星球上建造新的指挥中心并占领星球.
人工智能系统击杀奖励

英文: Single Planet Control Node: Auto-Build Engineers Mark II
中文: 单一星球控制指令: 自动生产工程师II型

英文:
Automatically places all of your engineers (including secondary engineers such as 
remains rebuilders) into Free-Roaming Defender mode if they are on planets you control. Low-power engineers will not be affected,
and engineers that already are acting on player orders will not be affected.
中文:
命令您的所有工程师(包括辅助工程师,如残骸重建机)进入自由巡逻模式,只要他们是在您所控制的星球上就有效.
低能量的工程师将不受影响,已有其他命令的工程师也不受影响.

英文: Multiple Launcher Rocket System fires multiple mid-power rockets.
中文: 多管火箭炮发射许多中等威力的火箭进行攻击.

英文:
Forcefield generator mountable on Riot Control Starships.  
Only of moderate power, but provides additional staying power and protects external weapon modules from enemy fire while it lasts.
Requires a medium hardpoint.
中文:
防暴星舰上的力场盾模块.
拥有中等能量,在持续期间保护其他模块免受敌人攻击.
需要1个中型炮挂点.

英文:
Each command station you control will automatically maintain one Mark III Engineer
at each planet you control.  Building multiple of this control node causes multiple engineers to be maintained at each planet.
Replacement engineers will only be built if there are fewer than 100 mobile enemy ships on the planet.
中文:
每个您控制的指挥中心将自动保持每个星球雄蜂工程师III型的数量为一个.
建造多个控制指令将使得每个星球上保持的雄蜂工程师III型的数量为多个.
工程师III型仅在星球上存在的敌人舰艇数少于100时被重建.
控制指令: 不撤退到友星

英文: Weak firepower but heavily armored.  Excellent against turrets.
中文: 火力低下,但装甲厚.善于对付炮塔.

英文:
A highly advanced cloaking device.  All team ships on the planet which this resides are utterly invisible,
even while firing, even if they normally would be visible.  They are also immune to tachyon beams and tachyon missiles.
中文:
高级的隐形装置.能使这个星球上所有友军的部队完全隐形,即使他们正在攻击敌人或者原本不是隐形的.
隐形仪对速子射线,速子飞弹免疫.

英文:
Creates a midsize force field that provides protection without reducing attack power of ships underneath.
Attack with several dozen Mark II Bombers (or better) to destroy.
Bombers have a substantial bonus against these and other hardened targets.
Snipers, Sniper Turrets, Raid/Leech Starships, Infiltrators, EyeBots, Ion Cannons,
and Counter-Spies can move and fire through force fields as if they are not there.
中文:
产生一个中型可移动的力场护盾来保护附近的部队.从力场里向外攻击伤害不减少.
数十架II型(或更高级)轰炸机一起攻击即可摧毁它.
轰炸机对力场及其他掩蔽目标有伤害加成.
狙击手,狙击塔,入侵者,突击/吸血星舰,潜入者,监察机,离子加农炮,
以及反间谍塔可以无视力场进行移动和攻击.

英文:
A massive, moon-sized space station created by the AI as the final defense against the human onslaught.
If the AI Home Command Station to which it is assigned is destroyed, the Avenger will live up to its name.
中文:
人工智能建造的最终要塞,用来作为抵抗人类玩家的最后手段.
如果它布置的星球上人工智能的指挥中心被摧毁了,它将展开强大而恐怖的报复,如它的名字所说的一样.

英文:
Fast starship that inflicts high damage on heavy defenses.
Excellent against force fields, heavy defenses, hardened targets, and other starships.
中文:
能对重型防御设施造成大量伤害的快速星舰.
很擅长对付力场,重型防御设施,掩蔽目标及其他的星舰.

英文:
Enemy ships coming too close to these deadly traps will incur heavy damage and most likely be destroyed.
Unlike standard mines, PermaMines are not destroyed in the process.  They can only be removed by Cleanup Drones once you own the planet.
To pass, you'll either have to go around, use an EMP, use transports, or use ships that have mine avoidance (Engineers, Mobile Builders, etc).
中文:
这些隐形的陷阱将对靠近的敌方部队造成很大的伤害.
不像普通空雷,重复空雷在爆炸后不被摧毁.它们只能在你占领这个星球后由清理雄蜂清理掉.
想要通过它们,你可以绕路,使用EMP攻击,瞬移,或使用能回避空雷的部队(工程师,机动兵工厂等).

英文: Passes through force fields and fires through shields.  Best in huge swarms.
中文: 可无视力场.适合集群作战.

英文:
Advanced multi-shot crowd control weapon.  
Fires at medium range and does engine damage.  Not as effective against strong shields.
Cannot reduce engines below 10%.
Requires a heavy hardpoint.
中文:
同时发射多个子弹进行攻击,比I型高级.
攻击范围适中,对引擎有伤害.对付重型护盾效果并不高.
无法将目标的引擎伤害到10%以下.
需要1个重型炮挂点.

英文:
Advanced laser cannon module mountable on Riot Control Starships. 
Longer range than the machine gun and effective against larger and more heavily shielded targets, but much less effective against small ships. 
Cannot reduce engines below 10%.
Requires an advanced light hardpoint.
中文:
防暴星舰上的高级镭射加农炮模块.
比机枪攻击范围更大,且对付大型目标和重型护盾的效率很高,但对付小型目标的效率不高.
无法将目标的引擎伤害到10%以下.
需要1个高级轻型炮挂点.

英文: Extremely effective at destroying starships, especially when massed.
中文: 长于破坏敌人的星舰, 特别是集群作战时.

英文: Teleporting battle station fires multiple lightning shots.
中文: 瞬移战役站可发射多重的闪雷攻击.

英文:
Causes a tachyon pulse when destroyed by enemy forces or by scrapping.
Reveals for 5 minutes all cloaked ships (enemy and allied alike) on the planet on which it is set off.
中文:
被敌人摧毁或被废弃时产生一个速子脉冲.
使爆炸点所在星球5分钟内隐形失效(包括己方和敌方).

英文: Fires electric bolts into ALL nearby enemy ships.
中文: 发出电气弹攻击附近的所有敌方部队.

英文:
Spinning blade mass crashes into enemies, damaging itself and them.  Shields offer no protection.
Unless issued a specific command by its controller, it will automatically attack nearby enemies.
中文:
使用旋转的刀片攻击敌人,伤人同时伤己.力场无法提供保护.
除非指挥官下命令,否则它会自动攻击附近的敌人.
突击所有范围内的敌军

英文:
Standard fighters upgraded with armor that repels all shell-based fire.
Excellent against starships in large numbers.
中文:
由标准歼击机升级装甲而来,可抵挡所有实弹攻击.
以群体对付星舰有极佳的效果.

英文:
Creates a small force field that provides protection without reducing attack power of ships underneath.
Attack with several dozen Mark I Bombers (or better) to destroy.
Bombers have a substantial bonus against these and other hardened targets.
Snipers, Sniper Turrets, Raid/Leech Starships, Infiltrators, EyeBots, Ion Cannons,
and Counter-Spies can move and fire through force fields as if they are not there.
中文:
产生一个小型可移动的力场护盾来保护附近的部队.从力场里向外攻击伤害不减少.
数十架I型(或更高级)轰炸机一起攻击即可摧毁它.
轰炸机对力场及其他掩蔽目标有伤害加成.
狙击手,狙击塔,入侵者,突击/吸血星舰,潜入者,监察机,离子加农炮,
以及反间谍塔可以无视力场进行移动和攻击.

英文: Fires shots to disable any missile ammo coming within its range.
中文: 炮弹射击以防止任何在其范围内的导弹攻击.

英文:
Generates a moderate amount of energy at a moderate cost-to-benefit ratio.
Efficiency goes down by 20% for each new reactor of this type built on the same planet.
中文:
以中等的成本与效益比,生成中等能量.
同一星球上每多建一个这个类型的反应装置,新的反应装置效率下降20%,效率下降会累积.

英文:
Inexpensive, lightly armored and armed starship.
Strong against force fields and turrets, and boosts the strength of nearby smaller ships.
中文:
廉价的轻型装甲武装星舰.
善于对抗力场和炮塔,并能提高周围小型舰艇的能力.
星际之门(增援- 只有AI可用)
重火力行星基地防御设施.

英文: Mercenary ships are more expensive than their normal counterparts, but they have no ship cap.
中文: 雇佣兵舰艇比同类正常舰艇昂贵,但他们没有数量限制.

英文: The command station on this planet will automatically maintain one Mark II Engineer.  Building multiple of this control node causes multiple engineers to be maintained at this planet. Replacement engineers will only be built if there are fewer than 100 mobile enemy ships on the planet.
中文:
您控制的这个指挥中心将自动保持这个星球雄蜂工程师II型的数量为一个.
建造多个控制指令将使得这个星球上保持的雄蜂工程师II型的数量为多个.
工程师II型仅在星球上存在的敌人舰艇数少于100时被重建.

英文:
Nearly-indestructible robotic courier.  Slightly damages nearby ships, damages constructors, heavy defense, and turrets more heavily.
More importantly, they reveal any cloaked ships that come near, and they tend to disrupt player minefields.
Build Counter-Dark-Matter Turrets to protect against them, or destroy Astro Train Stations to re-route them.
中文:
几乎不能被摧毁的装甲先锋.
能轻微地伤害附近的部队,对兵工厂和重型防御设施造成不低的伤害,并能对炮塔造成严重伤害.
更重要的是,它们能显示周围任何隐形单位,并能破坏玩家的空雷.
建造反物质炮塔来对付它们,或者摧毁敌人的星际列车站来改变它的移动路线.

英文:
A formerly captive city filled with living humans.  AI progress will skyrocket by 100 if this is destroyed.
These civilians have decided to rebel, and have erected a temporary invisibility cloak while they call for aid.
When the cloak dissipates, they'll be vulnerable to attacks from the AI, and surely won't last long.
When the rebels have supply, your entire team can use their facilities to build rebel ships.
While you hold the planet on which they are located, their invisibility cloak will remain at full power.
中文:
曾是人类俘虏居住的城市.被摧毁时人工智能进度将上升100点!
这些人类已经决心发动反叛,在他们呼叫援助时建造了一个临时的隐形装置.
当隐形装置失效时,他们将面对人工智能的报复,显然,他们撑不久的.
当起义组织获得补给时,您的队伍将可以使用他们的工厂来建造反抗军飞船.
当您获得了起义组织所在星球的控制权时,他们的隐形装置将可以一直工作下去.

英文:
Acts as a scout, passes through force fields, and is missile-proof.
Has cloaking and cloaking booster abilities like regular scouts.  Excellent against turrets.
中文:
可用于侦察,能通过力场,并能防御导弹.
拥有类似于侦察机的隐形与隐形强化能力.对炮塔效果良好.

英文:
Pockets of human allies who still live in deep space around AI planets will occasionally
send these versatile fighter/bomber hybrids to aid you in the fight against the AI at their local planet.
They won't attack any AI ships that human players must normally manually target.
中文:
外太空残存在人工智能星球周围的人类有时会派遣这些多功能轰炸机来帮助你对抗人工智能.
人类玩家如果必须手动操作才能攻击特定的人工智能的部队,那么反抗军轰炸机不会攻击它们.

英文:
Creates a huge mobile force field that provides protection without reducing attack power of ships underneath.
Attack with many dozen Mark III/IV Bombers (or better) to destroy.
Bombers have a substantial bonus against these and other hardened targets.
Snipers, Sniper Turrets, Raid/Leech Starships, Infiltrators, EyeBots, Ion Cannons,
and Counter-Spies can move and fire through force fields as if they are not there.
中文:
产生一个巨型可移动的力场护盾来保护附近的部队.从力场里向外攻击伤害不减少.
数十架III型或IV型(或更高级)轰炸机一起攻击即可摧毁它.
轰炸机对力场及其他掩蔽目标有伤害加成.
狙击手,狙击塔,入侵者,突击/吸血星舰,潜入者,监察机,离子加农炮,
以及反间谍塔可以无视力场进行移动和攻击.

英文: Inexpensive, with a small attack range. Great against many smaller ships.  Also excellent against starships in numbers.
中文: 价格便宜,攻击范围小.对付小型机体有良好的效果.而且以群体对付星舰有极佳的效果.

英文: Great for weakening targets at extreme distances.  Able to fire through force fields.
中文: 能够在极远的距离攻击目标,其攻击能穿透力场.
能一击必杀隐形的部队.
指令:不集合到盟友召集号

英文: Inflicts high damage on heavy defenses.  Best ship class for hitting force fields and the final AI command stations.
中文: 能对防御设施造成可观的伤害.善于对付力场和人工智能指挥中心.
控制指令: 机动兵工厂自动巡逻

英文: x AI Reinforcement While At Planet
中文: 倍人工智能增援，当它在星球中的时候

英文: Heavily slows the movement of all ships (not just enemy ships) in a larger range.
中文: 在大型范围内严重减慢所有部队的移动(包括己方和敌方).

英文:
Emits a powerful explosion of lightning that damages nearby enemy ships on detonation.
Can be given a direct target that it will chase and then explode near, or it will explode on death.
中文:
发射出一个强大的闪雷并爆炸,能损伤爆炸点附近的所有敌人.
能给予它一个目标,它会追踪目标并引爆,或在途中被摧毁而爆炸.

英文:
Incredibly powerful long-range beam cannon capable of vaporizing fleets of smaller ships at once.
The design is based on the only extant scraps of data from a mad scientist's plans for a doomsday weapon utilizing a sun as a power source.
中文:
可以让多个小型目标一下子人间蒸发.
设计方案来自一位疯狂科学家,他残留的计划中提出了这个将恒星作为能源来发动的灭世武器.

命令您的所有机动兵工厂进入自由巡逻模式,只要他们是在您所控制的星球上就有效.
低能量的,移动攻击中的单位将不受影响,已有其他命令的单位也不受影响.

英文: Very fast ship. Grabs allied starships with less than 100% health remaining and brings them to the nearest mobile repair station.
中文: 速度非常快.把机能少于100%的星舰牵引至最近的机动维修中心.
控制指令: 工程师自动巡逻

英文:
Capturable construction unit that allows human players to build a single type of core ship at this one location.
This fabricator allows players to build:
中文:
可占领的工厂,占领后允许您建造某一种核心部队.
该工厂允许您建造:
核心人工智能力场产生器

英文:
A captive city filled with living humans.  AI progress will skyrocket by 100 if this is destroyed.
Worse, while your team holds it, the AIs will send 3x stronger waves against this planet.
The city does provide you with a moderate amount of metal/crystal income, but the penalties often outweigh this.
中文:
人类俘虏居住的城市.被摧毁时人工智能进度将上升100点!
更糟糕的是,当你拥有它时,人工智能将派出为平时3倍的部队对这个星球进行进攻.
城市可以为你提供不少的金属/水晶收入,但一旦失去城市,你会失去更多.
单星指令:自产残骸重建机

英文: Locks on to up to forty-eight enemy ships, preventing them from moving (but not from firing).
中文: 锁定多达48个敌人的部队,使它们不能移动(可以攻击).

英文: x AI Wave Size While Humans Hold
中文: 倍人工智能攻势，当人类拥有它的时候

英文:
Generates a huge amount of energy, but at a poor cost-to-benefit ratio.
Efficiency goes down by 80% for each new reactor of this type built on the same planet.
中文:
以极高的成本与效益比,生成极多能量.
同一星球上每多建一个这个类型的反应装置,新的反应装置效率下降80%,效率下降会累积.

英文: Extremely effective at damaging the engines of enemy ships.
中文: 长于破坏敌人部队的引擎.

英文: Fast mobile ship with moderate attack and the ability to reveal any cloaked enemy ships in a wide arc.
中文: 中等攻击,移动速度较快.可以显示较大范围内的隐形战舰.

英文:
Repairs damaged ships or can accelerate construction done by other ships.
Unless issued a specific command by its controller, it will automatically repair nearby allies.
中文:
修复受损的部队,加快其他部队的建造速度.
除非指挥官下命令,否则它会自动修复附近的友军.
轨道指挥中心-雷达干扰器

英文:
Ships that are in FRD mode will not engage targets that are more than 80,000 meters distant.
This can be useful to keep ships from straying after marauders, unless you prefer that they stray (as some do).
中文:
处于自由巡逻模式的单位将不会与超过80,000米以外的敌人纠缠.
这可以让您的单位不会一直跟着敌人游荡,除非您喜欢这样.

英文:
Allied ships that are sent to this planet will gather at this rally post.
If there are multiple allied rally posts on a single planet, entering ships will pick one of them at random.
中文:
来到此星球的友军飞船将在召集号处聚集.
如果一个星球上有多个召集号,进入的部队将会随机选择一个.

英文: Control Node: Engineers To Not Auto-Assist Queues
中文: 控制指令: 工程师不会自动协助生产

英文:
Useless remains of an exploded mine.  
Scrap to clear the way for replacement, or leave in place so that a Remains Rebuilder can rebuild it. 
Remains belonging to enemies can be cleared by cleanup drones.
中文:
空雷爆炸后的残骸.
可以将它清理掉以布设新的空雷,或者让残骸重建机来重建它.
敌人的空雷残骸可以由清理雄蜂清理掉.

英文:
Creates a large, mobile force field that provides protection for nearby ships.
Ships firing out from under the force field do 75% less damage than normal, so it is best to build defenses around the field.
Bombers have a substantial bonus against these and other hardened targets.
Snipers, Sniper Turrets, Raid/Leech Starships, Infiltrators, EyeBots, Ion Cannons,
and Counter-Spies can move and fire through force fields as if they are not there.
中文:
产生一个大型可移动的力场护盾来保护附近的部队.
部队从力场里向外攻击将只造成75%的伤害,所以最好是在力场周围建造防御设施.
轰炸机对力场及其他掩蔽目标有伤害加成.
狙击手,狙击塔,入侵者,突击/吸血星舰,潜入者,监察机,离子加农炮,
以及反间谍塔可以无视力场进行移动和攻击.

英文: The first team to destroy all their opponents' home planet command stations is the winner.
中文: 第一个摧毁所有敌人的母星指挥中心的团队将胜利.

英文: Makes engineers prefer to assist non-mobile-military ships so they don't get bogged down repairing your fleets.
中文: 使工程师倾向于维修您的非战斗单位,以免他们卷入战争中并被摧毁.

英文:
Multiplex tractor beam module for Riot Control Starships.  
Can immobilize up to 10 craft at once.
Requires a medium hardpoint, but cannot be mounted on a MkII.
中文:
防暴星舰上的牵引模块.
一次可牵引至多10个敌人.
需要1个中型炮挂点,且不能装配在防暴星舰II型上.

英文: Cloaked fighter excellent for bypassing enemy defenses (such as mines and tractor beams).
中文: 能绕过敌人防御的隐形战机(如空雷和牵引光束).

英文: Excellent for attacking enemy armor and other targets at high range.
中文: 大范围攻击,用来对付敌人的高装甲目标效果很好.

英文: Mines crystal found amidst rock deposits.  Build on top of crystal deposits (white dots on minimap).
中文: 在岩石中发掘水晶矿.必须建造在水晶采集点上(小地图中的白点).

英文:
Hostile human vagabonds who live in deep space will occasionally send these extremely long-range frigates
at human and AI settlements to destroy what they can so that they can escape with the resulting scrap.
They won't attack any AI ships that human players must normally manually target.
中文:
居住在外太空的流浪者们有时会发送这些攻击范围相当大的护卫舰来摧毁他们所能看到的一切.
人类玩家如果必须手动操作才能攻击特定的人工智能的部队,那么短刀护卫舰不会攻击它们.

英文: Control Node: Reclaimed Units Rally to Rally Posts
中文: 控制指令: 重新集合到我军的召集号
星际之门(攻击- 只有AI可用)
被破坏时放射电磁脉冲

英文:
Each command station you control will automatically maintain one Remains Rebuilder
at each planet you control.  Building multiple of this control node causes multiple rebuilders to be maintained at each planet.
Replacement rebuilders will only be built if there are fewer than 100 mobile enemy ships on the planet.
中文:
每个您控制的指挥中心将自动保持每个星球残骸重建机的数量为一个.
建造多个控制指令将使得每个星球上保持的残骸重建机的数量为多个.
残骸重建机仅在星球上存在的敌人舰艇数少于100时被重建.

英文: Moderately slows the movement of all ships (not just enemy ships) in a midsized range.
中文: 在中型范围内减慢所有部队的移动(包括己方和敌方).

英文: Locks on to up to ten enemy ships, preventing them from moving (but not from firing).
中文: 锁定多达10个敌人的部队,使它们不能移动(可以攻击).

英文:
The galaxy's most deadly frigate.
Very strong against large groups of ships, and boosts the strength of nearby smaller ships.
中文:
这个星系中最可怕的星舰.
善于对抗大群敌人,并能提高周围小型舰艇的能力.

英文: Single Planet Control Node: Auto-Build Remains Rebuilders
中文: 单一星球控制指令: 自动生产残骸重建机

英文: Research and unlock new technologies.  Also gathers up to 2,000 knowledge per planet.
中文: 研究并解锁新的科技.也可以用于收集知识,每个星球最多2000点.
星际之门(所有- 只有AI可用)

英文:
Enemy ships will not leave their post unless it is destroyed.
When an AI gets reinforcements to a planet, each guard post also gets reinforcements.
中文:
敌方部队不会离开他们的据点,除非据点被摧毁.
当人工智能增援一个星球时,所有据点也将获得增援.

英文: This invisible guard post is destroyed when the command station is destroyed.
中文: 虫洞据点是隐形的.当指挥中心被摧毁时同时被摧毁.

英文: Reduces Power Of Nearby Incoming Lasers
中文: 减弱接近中的镭射攻击

英文:
Vault of advanced AI technology.  Capture to gain a new ship type for your team to build at space docks.
Never destroy these, but if it dies sometime after you capture it, you won't lose the technology you gained from it.
中文:
高级人工智能技术的研究中心.占领后能获得新型部队的建造技术,可应用于您及您的盟友.
永远不要摧毁它!如果在被占领后它被摧毁了,从中获得的技术也不会丢失.

英文: Very fast ship. Grabs allied ships with less than 33% engine health remaining and brings them to the nearest mobile repair station.
中文: 速度非常快.把引擎机能少于33%的舰艇牵引至最近的机动维修中心.

英文:
Mid-strength starship with high firepower.
Strong against large groups of ships, and boosts the strength of nearby smaller ships.
中文:
威力强大的中型星舰.
善于对抗大群敌人,并能提高周围小型舰艇的能力.

英文:
Generates powerful (and expensive) warheads over a long period of time.
Nukes in particular are very dangerous to use, and should only be attempted by advanced players.
Detonating any warhead causes the AI Progress to increase by some amount (the amount varies by the warhead).
中文:
能建造强大而昂贵的核弹头,但耗费时间较长.
使用核武器是非常危险的,只建议有经验的玩家使用.
引爆每一个核弹头将会增加一些人工智能进度(数量根据弹头类型而定).
控制指令: 非狙击单位集中火力

英文: Very heavily slows the movement of all ships (not just enemy ships) in a large range.
中文: 在更大型范围内极强地减慢所有部队的移动(包括己方和敌方).

英文: Normally metal and crystal manufactories will automatically enable and disable themselves to keep positive balances.  This control node disables that functionality.
中文:
通常金属与水晶制造工厂会自动调节它们的工作状态以保证不会浪费您的资源.
这项控制指令使得这项功能被关闭.

英文:
Incredibly powerful fortress with a massive range.  Only bombers and tanks have any chance against it.
Able to move around its planet, but too large to pass through wormholes.
Particularly strong against starships, teleporting units, and most units with cloaking.
Also repairs all nearby ships.
中文:
火力强劲,攻击范围大得恐怖的大型要塞.只有轰炸机和坦克能对付得了它.
能够在行星上移动,但无法通过虫洞.
对付星舰,瞬移单位,大部分隐形单位效果很显著.
可以修复所有附近的部队.

英文: Very fast ship. Grabs allied ships with less than 100% health remaining and brings them to the nearest mobile repair station.
中文: 速度非常快.把机能少于100%的舰艇牵引至最近的机动维修中心.

英文:
Inflicts high damage on heavy defenses.  Best ship class for hitting force fields and the final AI command stations.
Identical to the Bomber Mark II, except 10x more expensive and with no ship cap.
中文:
能对防御设施造成可观的伤害.善于对付力场和人工智能指挥中心.
机体性能与轰炸机II型相同,虽然是原价的十倍,但并没有数量限制.

英文:
The first team to destroy all their opponents' home planet command stations is the winner.
If one player controls multiple home planet command stations, destroying one will destroy them all.
However, while one player controls multiple home planet command stations, the ship caps of the player will be increased.
中文:
第一个摧毁所有敌人的母星指挥中心的团队将胜利.
若一个玩家控制多个母星指挥中心,当其中一个被摧毁时,其他的母星指挥中心也将被摧毁.
但是,若一个玩家控制多个母星指挥中心,他的部队上限将提高.

英文:
Slow moving, but emits lightning into ALL nearby enemy ships.
Stronger than their stats look in midsize-to-large groups.
中文:
移动缓慢,但是能发射闪雷同时伤害周围所有敌人.
在中到大规模集群作战时,实际效果比它的数值要好.

英文: Advanced weapon insta-kills most Mark I ships (and many ships with no Mark level at all).  Cannot fire upon ships immune to insta-kill.
中文: 可以一击必杀大部分I型部队(和无等级的普通部队).不能对免疫一击必杀的部队开火.

英文: Inexpensive, basic defense for planetary bases.
中文: 价格便宜,多作为行星基地的基本防御设施.

英文: Creates the fighters, bombers, frigates, and other ships that will comprise most of your fleet.
中文: 建造歼击机,轰炸机,护卫舰,以及其他舰艇来组建你的舰队.

英文: AI Reinforces When This Enters AI Planet x
中文: 当它进入人工智能的星球时，人工智能增援 x

英文: Massive beam cannon only mountable on the largest of space stations.
中文: 只能装载在最大的空间站上.

英文: CAPTURABLE SHIP: Your ships will not fire on this, but you can capture it by taking the planet, and either scrap or use it as you wish.
中文: 可占领的飞船:您的飞船不会自动对这些目标开火,但一旦您占领了它们所在的行星,它们就是你的了.

英文: Very fast ship. Grabs allied ships with less than 66% engine health remaining and brings them to the nearest mobile repair station.
中文: 速度非常快.把引擎机能少于66%的舰艇牵引至最近的机动维修中心.
控制指令: 禁止制造工厂自动运作

英文: Very fast ship. Grabs allied starships with less than 33% health remaining and brings them to the nearest mobile repair station.
中文: 速度非常快.把机能少于33%的星舰牵引至最近的机动维修中心.

英文: Single Planet Control Node: Auto-Build Engineers Mark I
中文: 单一星球控制指令: 自动生产工程师I型

英文: Fires powerful, long-range missiles, but has a very slow reload time.
中文: 火力强劲,能发射远程导弹进行攻击,但需要很长的时间来重新装填弹药.

英文:
Close-combat ship that repairs itself when it damages enemies.
Unless issued a specific command by its controller, it will automatically attack nearby enemies.
中文:
近距离作战机,对敌人造成伤害时能修理机身的损伤.
除非指挥官下命令,否则它会自动攻击附近的敌人.

英文: Control Node: FRD Stance Range Limited To 80,000
中文: 控制指令: 巡逻范围限制在80,000米以内。

英文:
Repairs damaged ships or can accelerate construction done by other ships.
Unless issued a specific command by its controller, it will automatically repair nearby allies.
Identical to the basic engineer, except has faster repair rate and a larger repair range.
中文:
修复受损的部队,加快其他部队的建造速度.
除非指挥官下命令,否则它会自动修复附近的友军.
性能与工程师类似,但它修复速度更快,维修范围更大.

英文: The largest beam cannon mountable on a normal starship.  Generally said starship is built around the cannon, rather than the cannon being mounted on the starship.
中文:
普通舰艇能承载的最大的重型光束加农炮.
与其说加农炮装载在战舰上,不如说战舰是环绕着它而建.

英文:
Prevents your engineers from automatically assisting build queues
(keeping them on repair duty only, unless they are given explicit orders to accelerate a queue).
中文:
使您的工程师们不会自动协助建造单位.
这使他们可以集中精力进行维修工作,除非他们被给予了准确的指令来协助建造.

英文:
Useless remains.  
Scrap to clear the way for replacement, or leave in place so that a Remains Rebuilder can rebuild it. 
Remains belonging to enemies can be cleared by cleanup drones.
Remains are of:
中文:
无用的残骸.
可以将它清理掉,或者让残骸重建机来重建它.
敌人的残骸可以由清理雄蜂清理掉.
残骸属于:
控制权归于占领星球的一方

英文: Very fast ship. Grabs allied starships with less than 66% health remaining and brings them to the nearest mobile repair station.
中文: 速度非常快.把机能少于66%的星舰牵引至最近的机动维修中心.
控制指令: 工程师不会参与战争

英文:
Causes a electromagnetic explosion when destroyed by enemy forces or by scrapping.
Temporarily paralyzes most ships, disables cloaking, and disables force fields and mines on the planet on which it is set off.
EMP effects last for 30 seconds, and affect your ships as well as enemy ships.  Does not affect core ships or starships.
中文:
被敌人摧毁或被废弃时产生一个电磁脉冲.
使爆炸点所在星球大部分舰艇瘫痪,隐形,力场,空雷失效.
电磁脉冲持续30秒,影响所有部队,但不包括核心部队和星舰.

英文: Very fast ship. Grabs allied ships with less than 66% health remaining and brings them to the nearest mobile repair station.
中文: 速度非常快.把机能少于66%的舰艇牵引至最近的机动维修中心.

英文:
Extremely large, powerful, and expensive mobile defensive structure.
Particularly strong against starships, teleporting units, and most units with cloaking.
Can store up to 500 units inside itself to protect them during attacks.
Also acts as a Rally Post for incoming allied ships, and repairs all nearby ships.
中文:
强大而昂贵的巨型防御设施.
擅长对付其他星舰,瞬移单位及大部分隐形单位.
其内部可以容纳至多500个单位.
可以作为召集号,并可以修复周围所有部队.

英文: Reclaims enemy ships it kills (reclaimed ships have health = half damage inflicted by reclamator).
中文: 能够操控它摧毁的战舰(被操控的战舰机能为寄生虫造成的伤害的一半).

英文:
Advanced forcefield generator mountable on Riot Control Starships.  
Only of moderate power, but provides additional staying power and protects external weapon modules from enemy fire while it lasts.
Requires a heavy hardpoint.
中文:
防暴星舰上的高级力场盾模块.
拥有中等能量,在持续期间保护其他模块免受敌人攻击.
需要1个重型炮挂点.
吸引所有接近中的炮弹

英文: Large, blazing-fast cloaked fighter good against infrastructure and many smaller ships.
中文: 大型隐形战斗机,行动迅速,对付基础设施与小型舰艇有良好的效果.

英文: Locks on to up to twenty-four enemy ships, preventing them from moving (but not from firing).
中文: 锁定多达24个敌人的部队,使它们不能移动(可以攻击).

英文: AI Progress If Killed Or Scrapped
中文: 人工智能系统击杀惩罚

英文: Prevents scout evasion behavior when exiting a wormhole onto a friendly planet.
中文: 使侦察机离开虫洞进入一个友军星球时不会逃离一段距离.

英文: Orbital Command Station Home Core Mark II
Attack Power Boost For Allied Ships

Laser cannon module mountable on Riot Control Starships. 
Longer range than the machine gun and effective against larger and more heavily shielded targets, but much less effective against small ships. 
Cannot reduce engines below 25%.
Requires a light hardpoint.
中文:
防暴星舰上的镭射加农炮模块.
比机枪攻击范围更大,且对付大型目标和重型护盾的效率很高,但对付小型目标的效率不高.
无法将目标的引擎伤害到25%以下.
需要1个轻型炮挂点.

英文: The command station on this planet will automatically maintain one Remains Rebuilder.  Building multiple of this control node causes multiple rebuilders to be maintained at this planet. Replacement rebuilders will only be built if there are fewer than 100 mobile enemy ships on the planet.
中文:
您控制的这个指挥中心将自动保持这个星球残骸重建机的数量为一个.
建造多个控制指令将使得这个星球上保持的残骸重建机的数量为多个.
残骸重建机仅在星球上存在的敌人舰艇数少于100时被重建.

英文:
The ultimate scout, firing its own tachyon beams while immune to the tachyon beams of enemies.
This makes the scout completely undetectable, but the tradeoff is that it is only able to move very slowly.
中文:
终级侦察机,发射其特有的速子射线以避开敌人的速子射线.
它完全无法被察觉到,但行动非常缓慢.

英文:
Stationary defense platform mounting a massive long-range beam cannon.
The beam can vaporize multiple smaller craft in one blast, or do heavy damage to a larger target.
中文: 可以让多个小型目标一下子人间蒸发,也可以对一个大型目标造成可怕的伤害.

英文:
Inexpensive, with a small attack range. Great against many smaller ships.  Also excellent against starships in numbers.
Identical to the Standard Fighter Mark II, except 10x more expensive and with no ship cap.
中文:
价格便宜,攻击范围小.对付小型机体有良好的效果.而且以群体对付星舰有极佳的效果.
机体性能与标准歼击机II型相同,虽然是原价的十倍,但并没有数量限制.

英文: Makes non-sniper units use an alternate autotargetting behavior to focus on maximizing rapid enemy casualties.  This behavior was developed for sniper units, so use with caution.
中文:
使非狙击部队集中力量尽可能地造成敌人的伤亡.
这个指令最适用于狙击单位,应用于非狙击单位前请三思.

英文: The command station on this planet will automatically maintain one Mark III Engineer.  Building multiple of this control node causes multiple engineers to be maintained at this planet. Replacement engineers will only be built if there are fewer than 100 mobile enemy ships on the planet.
中文:
您控制的这个指挥中心将自动保持这个星球雄蜂工程师III型的数量为一个.
建造多个控制指令将使得这个星球上保持的雄蜂工程师III型数量为多个.
工程师III型仅在星球上存在的敌人舰艇数少于100时被重建.

英文:
This one-way wormhole leads to somewhere outside the galaxy.
A mysterious force prevents your ships from going through.
This wormhole cannot be destroyed, and it will continue letting 
enemy ships into the galaxy until you finish off both AIs and win the war.
中文:
这个单行的虫洞通往星系外.
一股神秘的力量阻止了您进入虫洞.
外星虫洞永远不能被摧毁.除非您干掉了人工智能并赢得了游戏,否则它将源源不断地传送部队进入星系.

英文: Weak, mobile ship reacts with nearby enemy cloaked ships, making them trackable for a short while.
中文: 弱小的舰艇.可发现附近的隐形敌舰,使它们在短时间内被追踪.

英文:
Provides better warning of incoming enemy warps to a planet.
Wormholes through which a warp will arrive will flash on the minimap, and will turn orange in the main view.
中文:
可以提前对敌人的入侵发出预警.
当敌人要通过虫洞跃迁时,小地图上虫洞图标将闪烁,并且在主界面中变成橙色.

英文:
Slow artillery-style starship with very high range.
Excellent against starships, munitions boosters, fighters of all sorts, heavy defenses, and command stations.
中文:
装备攻击范围极大的慢射速火炮.
很擅长对付其他星舰,火力增幅器,所有战斗机与歼击机,重型防御设施及指挥中心.

英文: Tiny fighters best in swarms.  Reveals any cloaked enemy ships they come near.
中文: 微型战斗机最好是随舰队作战而不是单独行动.能发现附近隐形的敌人.

英文:
Does relatively low damage, but has high health and provides a mini force field to protect allied ships.
Its force field does not reduce the attack power of protected ships.
中文:
攻击威力并不高,但机能很高且能在周围制造一个小型的力场护盾来保护附近的友军.
该力场护盾并不减少被保护的部队的火力.

英文:
Specializes in disabling and destroying large numbers of weaker disturbances to the peace.
Redesigned to support an advanced electrical discharge weapon, but unable to sustain a tractor beam.
Has two light hardpoints, one advanced light hardpoint, two medium hardpoints, and one heavy hardpoint.
中文:
用来对付大量敌人的压制性兵器.
重新设计用来安装防暴电气枪,但因此不能再安装防暴牵引机.
拥有2个轻型炮挂点,1个高级轻型炮挂点,2个中型炮挂点,1个重型炮挂点.

英文:
Capturable construction unit that allows human players to build a single type of experimental starship at this one location.
This fabricator allows players to build:
中文:
可占领的星舰工厂,占领后允许您建造某一种试验性星舰.
该工厂允许您建造:

英文: Generates an incredible amount of resources, but also causes an incredible increase in AI Progress if lost.
中文: 产生多得令人难以置信的资源,但一旦被摧毁人工智能进度将大大提升.

英文: Mines metal found amidst wreckage.  Build on top of energy capsules (white dots on minimap).
中文: 在残骸中发掘金属矿.必须建造在金属采集点上(小地图中的白点).
控制指令: 自动生产残骸重建机
人工智能系统击杀惩罚(只适用于人工智能)

英文:
Reclaims enemy ships it kills (reclaimed ships have health = half damage inflicted by reclamator).
Very low main attack, but strikes huge numbers of ships at once (marking them for reclamation if any ship kills them).
中文:
能够操控它摧毁的战舰(被操控的战舰机能为吸血星舰造成的伤害的一半).
伤害很低,但是可以一次攻击大量的部队(被攻击的战舰被任意部队摧毁时也将被操控).

英文:
Nerve center of every planetary base.  All other base buildings are created here.
Can only build one per planet (counting all players). Can be built at destroyed planets, but provide no supply there.
中文:
每一个行星基地的核心.所有其他基础建筑都是由它建造的.
每个星球只能建造一个(包括所有玩家).可建造在被摧毁的星球,但无法提供补给.

英文:
Manufacturing core spawned from an Advanced Factory.  
Allows human players other than the one capturing the system to construct Mark IV ships.  
Invulnerable but will be removed if the parent factory is destroyed.
中文:
从高级兵工厂制造的核心.
允许除了控制高级兵工厂外的人类玩家制造4型部队.
仅当母工厂被摧毁时被摧毁.

英文:
Creates a large mobile force field that provides protection without reducing attack power of ships underneath.
Attack with several dozen Mark III Bombers (or better) to destroy.
Bombers have a substantial bonus against these and other hardened targets.
Snipers, Sniper Turrets, Raid/Leech Starships, Infiltrators, EyeBots, Ion Cannons,
and Counter-Spies can move and fire through force fields as if they are not there.
中文:
产生一个大型可移动的力场护盾来保护附近的部队.从力场里向外攻击伤害不减少.
数十架III型(或更高级)轰炸机一起攻击即可摧毁它.
轰炸机对力场及其他掩蔽目标有伤害加成.
狙击手,狙击塔,入侵者,突击/吸血星舰,潜入者,监察机,离子加农炮,
以及反间谍塔可以无视力场进行移动和攻击.

英文:
Specializes in disabling and destroying large numbers of weaker disturbances to the peace.
Has three advanced light hardpoints, two medium hardpoints, and two heavy hardpoints.
中文:
用来对付大量敌人的压制性兵器.
拥有3个高级轻型炮挂点,2个中型炮挂点,2个重型炮挂点.

英文: Prevents your ships from rallying to allied rally posts; they will still rally to rally posts specifically owned by you.
中文: 使您的部队不自动集合到盟友的召集号处,但仍然会集合到您的召集号处.

英文:
Advanced AI technology allows the AI to add reinforcements to this planet at double the normal rate.
Destroying this causes the AI Progress to increase by 10.
中文:
高级人工智能技术使人工智能的增援速度为通常速度的2倍.
被摧毁时人工智能进度上升10点.

英文:
Creates a small, mobile force field that provides protection for nearby ships.
Ships firing out from under the force field do 75% less damage than normal, so it is best to build defenses around the field.
Bombers have a substantial bonus against these and other hardened targets.
Snipers, Sniper Turrets, Raid/Leech Starships, Infiltrators, EyeBots, Ion Cannons,
and Counter-Spies can move and fire through force fields as if they are not there.
中文:
产生一个小型可移动的力场护盾来保护附近的部队.
部队从力场里向外攻击将只造成75%的伤害,所以最好是在力场周围建造防御设施.
轰炸机对力场及其他掩蔽目标有伤害加成.
狙击手,狙击塔,入侵者,突击/吸血星舰,潜入者,监察机,离子加农炮,
以及反间谍塔可以无视力场进行移动和攻击.

英文: Waypoint for astro trains.  Destroy to re-route trains.
中文: 星际列车的车站.摧毁它将改变星际列车的移动路线.

英文:
Prevents your engineers from automatically assisting any allied ships
(though you can still manually assign them to assist specific allied ships).
中文:
使您的工程师们不会自动协助维修友军单位
当然您可以手动控制他们进行维修工作.

英文: Stronger, fixed ship reacts with nearby enemy cloaked ships, making them trackable for a short while.
中文: 较强的舰艇.可发现附近的隐形敌舰,使它们在短时间内被追踪.

英文:
Expensive method for generating metal.  Useful when access to junk piles is limited.
Will normally pause and unpause itself to maintain an ideal economy without wasting your resources.
A control node can be built (from the CTRL tab of the build menu) to let you manually control this.
中文:
使用昂贵的方法制造金属.当金属紧缺时可能会很有用.
自动改变工作状态以保证不会浪费您的资源.也可以通过控制指令手动控制(通过建造菜单--控制选项).

英文:
Long-range defense for planetary bases.
Also useful on offense, since it can fire through force fields.
中文:
远程行星基地防御设施.
进攻上也很有用,因为它的攻击可穿透力场.

英文: Control Node: Auto-Build Engineers Mark I
中文: 控制指令: 自动生产工程师I型

英文: Control Node: Auto-Build Engineers Mark II
中文: 控制指令: 自动生产工程师II型

英文:
Place on metal or crystal harvesters to create a tiny force field around them.
Attack with several dozen Mark I Bombers (or better) to destroy.
Bombers have a substantial bonus against these and other hardened targets.
Snipers, Sniper Turrets, Raid/Leech Starships, Infiltrators, EyeBots, Ion Cannons,
and Counter-Spies can move and fire through force fields as if they are not there.
中文:
为金属采矿厂或水晶采集厂创造一个微小的力场.
数十架I型(或更高级)轰炸机一起攻击即可摧毁它.
轰炸机对力场及其他掩蔽目标有伤害加成.
狙击手,狙击塔,入侵者,突击/吸血星舰,潜入者,监察机,离子加农炮,
以及反间谍塔可以无视力场进行移动和攻击.

英文:
Research and unlock new technologies.  Also gathers up to 2,000 knowledge per planet.
Costs much more than a regular lab, but is heavily armored to aid gathering in enemy territory.
中文:
研究并解锁新的科技.也可以用于收集知识,每个星球最多2000点.
比普通实验室建造成本高,但其重型装甲可帮助它到敌人的领地内收集知识.

英文: Makes units with infinite range (sniper turrets, snipers, etc) use an alternate autotargetting behavior to focus on maximizing rapid enemy casualties.
中文: 使攻击范围无限的部队(狙击手,狙击塔等)集中力量尽可能地造成敌人的伤亡.

英文: Relatively low combat value, but is cloaked, emits tachyon beams, fires counter-sniper flares, and acts as a scout.
中文: 实战价值不高,但它是隐形的,并且能发射速子束,反狙击照明弹,也可进行侦察.

英文:
Each command station you control will automatically maintain one Mark II Engineer
at each planet you control.  Building multiple of this control node causes multiple engineers to be maintained at each planet.
Replacement engineers will only be built if there are fewer than 100 mobile enemy ships on the planet.
中文:
每个您控制的指挥中心将自动保持每个星球雄蜂工程师II型的数量为一个.
建造多个控制指令将使得每个星球上保持的雄蜂工程师II型的数量为多个.
工程师II型仅在星球上存在的敌人舰艇数少于100时被重建.

英文: AI Force Field Generator Mark III
中文: 人工智能力场产生器III型

英文: Makes ships reclaimed by you automatically rally to one of your rally posts in the system (if any).
中文: 使您的部队重新集合到我军的召集号上,只要星系内有我们的召集号就有效.

英文:
Enemy ships coming too close to these invisible traps will incur heavy damage.
The mine is also destroyed in the process.
中文:
这些隐形的陷阱将对靠近的敌方部队造成很大的伤害.
爆炸后自身也被摧毁.

英文: AI Force Field Generator Mark II
中文: 人工智能力场产生器II型

英文:
Small, lightning-fast starship with powerful lasers.  Excellent for long-range raiding.
Can pass/shoot through force fields, and is exceptional at destroying force fields.
中文:
快如闪电的星舰,装备强大的激光武器.适合对敌军进行远程打击.
它可以通过力场,它的攻击可以穿透力场,而且善于破坏力场.

英文: Control Node: No Rallying to allied Rally Posts
中文: 控制指令: 不集合到盟友的召集号
控制指令: 狙击单位集中火力

英文:
Multi-shot crowd-control weapon.  
Fires at medium range and does engine damage.  Not as effective against strong shields.
Cannot reduce engines below 25%.
Requires a medium hardpoint.
中文:
同时发射多个子弹进行攻击.
攻击范围适中,对引擎有伤害.对付重型护盾效果并不高.
无法将目标的引擎伤害到25%以下.
需要1个中型炮挂点.

英文: Second and third tier of technologies for upgrading offensive capabilities.
中文: 升级此技术能提高您的部队战斗能力。

英文: Technologies for unlocking new ways of altering how your civilization works.
中文: 升级此技术能获得新的部队指挥命令。

英文: Technologies for upgrading your non-turret defensive capabilities.
中文: 升级此技术能增强您的非炮塔防御设施。

英文: Technologies for unlocking new kinds of starships.
中文: 升级此技术能取得新型星舰。
升级此技术能加强您的炮塔。

英文: Technologies for upgrading your economic capabilities.
中文: 升级此技术能增快您的经济发展。

英文: COLONY-HOPPING:  Once you have destroyed the command station on
中文: 跃迁突袭：一旦您摧毁了

英文:
1. Left-click your Command Station (or press the B key) and go to the ECON tab.
     2. Left-click the button labeled Engineer.
     3. Hold Ctrl and Left-click to place 5 new Engineers somewhere near your in-progress Lab.
中文:
1、左键单击您的指挥中心（或按下B键）并切换到经济选项卡。
     2、左键单击工程师的按钮（第三排从左数第一个）。
     3、按下Ctrl键并用左键单击放置可以一次性开始建造5个工程师（建议放置在实验室附近）。

英文: First, take a look at your resource indicators:
中文: 首先，看一看您的资源指示器：

英文:
1. Double-waves occur every so often in regular campaigns.  They have twice as many ships as usual.
2. The AI Progress has reached a point where waves are now Mark II.
中文:
1、双倍攻势在正常游戏里是相当经常发生的。此攻势敌人的部队数将是通常的两倍。
2、人工智能进度已经增加到使人工智能开始使用II型部队了。

英文: Assign your Engineer to double construction speed at your Dock.
中文: [必选任务1]让您的工程师加速部队建造。

英文:
Find your Colony Ship and use it to build a new Command Station anywhere you like on this planet.
     That's all there is to it, now that the enemy Command Station is gone!
中文:
找到您的殖民舰，使用它在当前行星建造一个新的指挥中心。
     一旦敌人的指挥中心被摧毁了，您就可以开始建造您的指挥中心了！

英文: Often this works best for distant planets when sending them in pairs or larger groups.
中文: 通常派遣大群侦察机来侦察远处的行星效果更好。

英文: is blocking our path forward, so that must be our next target.

中文: 自爆攻击敌人的单位,对敌人造成范围伤害.

英文:
Launches brutal waves against its own planet or any adjacent planets, if those planets are not controlled
by AI players, or if the human players have a significant fleet there.  If human players don't have warp sensors on these planets,
the waves may well arrive unannounced.  These waves arrive around every four minutes, contain a broad mix of AI ships, and use 
the tech level of the planet if that is higher than the current wave level for the controlling AI player.
中文: 对它所在的星球或相邻星球发动凶猛的攻势,如果那些星球不是人工智能控制的,或有主力舰队在上面.如果人类玩家在那些星球上没有高级星际跃迁探测器,那么攻势将不经警告直接到来.攻势每4分钟发动一次,包括各种类型的部队.如果当前星球科技等级比人工智能正常攻势部队的等级高,那么突击引擎发动的攻势部队等级将与当前星球科技等级一致.

英文:
Mobile ship that increases the speed of all friendly ships in the current system by a small amount.
This effect is cumulative when multiple speed boosters are present.
中文: 可移动单位,稍微增加所在星球上所有友军的移动速度.多个速度助推器的效果可以累积.

英文:
Advanced Zenith power generator that produces a massive amount of energy at a very tiny cost.
AI progress goes up by 20 if this is destroyed, and while your team holds it, the AIs will send 2x stronger waves against this planet.
中文: 以极小的代价产生大量能量的高级发电机.一旦被摧毁,人工智能进度将上升20点.当人类玩家拥有时敌人的攻势部队数将是通常的2倍.

英文:
Destroy to capture a large cache of Mark II Zenith vessels for your own use (at some AI Progress cost).
Given the large number of ships that come online at once, be sure to have between 400k 
and 1 million energy available to support them.
中文:
摧毁以获得大批天顶II型部队为您所用(需要以一些人工智能进度为代价).
获得的所有部队将即刻有效,请确保拥有400,000到1,000,000的能量以满足它们的需求.

英文: Midrange bomber that takes on the appearance of junk, and is unassailable, when not moving.
中文: 中距离轰炸机,看起来像太空垃圾,当不动时无法摧毁.

英文: Melee ship that generates build points as it attacks, spawning a free copy of itself when enough are accumulated.  This replication costs a portion of the replicator's health, and will not happen below a certain percent of health.  Also, when there are more shredders of a specific level than the natural ship cap on a single planet, the build points required to replicate will increase exponentially.
中文: 近战船只,攻击时产生BP,当BP满时将产生自身的复制体.当超过部队上限时,复制所需的BP将急速上升.

英文:
Cursed Golems continuously take passive damage, and so must constantly be repaired to survive.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on, and cause the AI Progress to increase as they are repaired from their broken form.
This golem is ancient and broken, and must be repaired to full health before it will become operational.
There will also need to be at least 200,000 net energy available before the golem will come online.
中文:
诅咒魔舰会不停地受到伤害,需要经常维修以保持生存.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援,当维修它们时人工智能进度将不停增加.
这艘魔舰相当残旧,当它可用之前必须完全维修它.
它还需要200,000的能量来驱动.

英文:
Reclaims enemy ships it kills (reclaimed ships have health = full damage inflicted by reclamator).
Reclaimed ships come back as Zombie Bots, which cannot be controlled but which will attack enemy ships 
mercilessly until they die.  Zombie bots will travel to enemy planets if no enemies present.  This golem damages itself
with zombie-creating shots, and cannot attack ships that are immobile, have no attack, or are immune to reclamation.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on, and cause the AI Progress to increase as they are repaired from their broken form.
This golem is ancient and broken, and must be repaired to full health before it will become operational.
There will also need to be at least 300,000 net energy available before the golem will come online.
中文:
能够操控它摧毁的战舰(被操控的战舰机能为僵尸网络魔舰造成的伤害).
被操控的战舰将成为僵尸部队,无法控制,但会无畏地进攻敌人,直至死亡为止.如果当前星球上没有敌人了,僵尸部队将前往敌人的其他星球.
僵尸网络魔舰在制造僵尸部队的同时会伤害自己,且不能攻击无法移动的单位,无法进行攻击的单位和对操控免疫的单位.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援,当维修它们时人工智能进度将不停增加.
这艘魔舰相当残旧,当它可用之前必须完全维修它.
它还需要300,000的能量来驱动.

英文: Fires straight through shields, and does higher damage to ships with more shielding.
中文: 攻击无视护盾,并能对高护盾目标造成更高伤害.

英文: Astro Speed Booster Train Mark III

When humans capture the planet on which this resides, they gain direct access to the core
network of the AI, where they can greatly damage the AI's processing capabilities. 
Every 15 seconds, this decreases AI Progress by one, but as a side effect, this increases AI Progress Floor by 0.2
At each reduction the terminal will spawn AI ships proportional to the total AI progress reduction.
For AI progress details, move the mouse cursor over the AI progress display at the top of the screen.
中文:
当人类玩家占领了终端机所在星球,他们就能直接连接到人工智能的核心网络来破坏它们的处理能力.
每15秒,终端机降低1点人工智能进度,但会增加0.2点人工智能进度基数.
每降低1次终端机产生与降低进度数成正比的人工智能部队.

英文: Attacks with ammo that reacts with enemy energy sources, doing much higher damage to ships with higher energy use.
中文: 攻击影响敌人部队能源,会对消耗能量多的单位造成更大伤害.

英文: Fires powerful high-range beam weapons that strike all enemy ships in a line.
中文: 发射远距离的光束同时突击一条线上的敌人.

英文:
Disables the shields of all enemy ships on the current planet, making them much easier to hit.
Also disables enemy force fields.
中文: 能使当前星球敌军的护盾完全无效化.也会使力场无效化.

英文:
Expensive bomber that delivers a tremendous payload, but loses attack power due to interference 
when too many are on the same planet. Most efficient in groups of 8 or less.
中文: 昂贵的轰炸机,极端强大,但一个星球上数量太多的话火力会急剧下降.最好保证每个星球上只有至多8艘.

英文: Provides 200% bonus to the shield strength of all allied ships on the current planet, making them far harder to hit.
中文: 能使当前星球友军的护盾增为原来的2倍.

英文:
When an AI Command Station is destroyed on the alarm post's planet, or an adjacent planet,
all of the guards at the current planet will desert their posts and go on the attack.  If the alarm post itself is
attacked and destroyed, there is only a 50% chance of it alerting the guards.
中文: 当警报器所在星球或相邻星球的指挥中心被摧毁时,当前星球上所有据点守卫部队将离开据点发动进攻.如果警报器被攻击或摧毁,有50%的机率使守卫部队发动攻击.

英文:
This golem is sent from deep space for one purpose: to consume the planet it is heading toward.
It will fire on human ships that approach it, but it emits a signal that tricks AI ships into ignoring it as harmless.
It takes it quite a while to reach the planet, but as soon as it does, it causes a blast the same as if a nuclear
weapon had been set off -- destroying all the resources and most ships, and making the planet unable to sustain supply.
中文:
从外太空出现的爆破魔舰只有一个目的:破坏行星.
它将向人类玩家的部队开火,但人工智能的部队不会理睬它.
它要花好长一段时间来到达目的地,但一旦到达,它就会释放一个类似核弹的冲击波,摧毁所有的采集点与大部分单位,并使星球无法被补给.

英文:
This massive immobile golem lurks at the edge of a planet's orbit -- conventional weapons cannot even damage it. 
If you free the planet from the AI, the sphere will realize your beneign intent and will help you on nearby planets.
If you take the planet for yourself, the sphere will attack you until you give up the planet.
中文:
巨大的戴森球魔舰藏在星球的轨道边缘--常规武器根本无法伤它分毫.
如果您把它所在星球的人工智能消灭了,戴森球会理解你的善意并帮助你进攻附近的人工智能星球.
如果您占领了它所在的星球,戴森球将攻击你,直到你放弃那个星球.

英文:
Large, slow transport that automatically fills over time with up to 500 small wasp ships.
When the wasps are unloaded, they will automatically spread out and attack enemy ships on the current planet;
they cannot be directly controlled, cannot leave the current planet, and lose health slowly over 3 minutes.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on, and cause the AI Progress to increase as they are repaired from their broken form.
This golem is ancient and broken, and must be repaired to full health before it will become operational.
There will also need to be at least 600,000 net energy available before the golem will come online.
中文:
巨大,移动缓慢的运输装置,自动制造黄蜂,最多可达500只.
黄蜂被卸载时将自动攻击敌人的部队;它们无法控制,无法离开当前星球,并且3分钟内机能会缓慢地下降.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援,当维修它们时人工智能进度将不停增加.
这艘魔舰相当残旧,当它可用之前必须完全维修它.
它还需要600,000的能量来驱动.

英文:
Large, slow transport that automatically fills over time with up to 500 small wasp ships.
When the wasps are unloaded, they will automatically spread out and attack enemy ships on the current planet;
they cannot be directly controlled, cannot leave the current planet, and lose health slowly over 3 minutes.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on.
中文:
巨大,移动缓慢的运输装置,自动制造黄蜂,最多可达500只.
黄蜂被卸载时将自动攻击敌人的部队;它们无法控制,无法离开当前星球,并且3分钟内机能会缓慢地下降.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援.

英文:
Nearly-indestructible robotic courier.  Slightly damages nearby ships.
More importantly, is able to use its own health to resurrect AI mobile ships that are killed on the current 
planet. Resurrected ships are teleported to another AI planet at full health at no cost beyond the health of 
the train. They also reveal any cloaked ships that come near. Destroy Astro Train Stations to re-route them.
中文:
几乎不能被摧毁的装甲先锋,能轻微地伤害附近的部队.
更重要的是,它们能使用自身的机能来使刚刚在此星球被摧毁的人工智能可移动部队立刻复活.被复活的单位将在另一个人工智能星球满状态出现,复活部队不需要付出任何资源.
它们也能显示靠近的隐形单位.摧毁星际列车站来改变它的移动路线.

英文: Launches mid-power grenades over medium distance.  Grenades explode on contact and deal area damage to enemies.
中文: 攻击范围中等,火力中等.榴弹在与目标接触时爆炸,造成范围伤害.

英文:
Mid-power main attack, but has the unique ability to reflect all incoming shots against
its attackers.  With its shielding, can often deal out significantly more damage than it actually receives in this way.
Mirrors are very weak to area-of-effect, missiles, and melee attacks, since those cannot be reflected.
They also cannot reflect shots at a further range than the mirror can shoot on its own.
中文:
中等火力,拥有将敌人的攻击反弹回去的独特能力.由于它护盾较高,攻击它的部队往往没有好下场.
天顶镜对范围攻击,导弹和砍击较弱,因为它无法反弹这些攻击.
它也无法反弹超出天顶镜本身攻击范围的攻击.

英文: Doubles the attack of all allied ships on its planet and all adjacent planets.
中文: 能使当前星球与相邻星球的部队火力增为原来的2倍.

英文: Mid-power teleporting fighter that fires shots that cause enemy targets to be teleported far across the current planet when they are hit.
中文: 中等火力的瞬移战机,其攻击将造成敌人被随机传送到其他地方.

英文: Strong fighter in its own right, it also gives a 2x shielding bonus to nearby ships on your team.
中文: 战斗力强大的战机,能使附近的友军护盾增为原来的2倍.

英文:
A large station that bores a hole into the fabric of spacetime.  So brutal is the rending of normal 
space that the effects radiated from this rupture dramatically interfere with most known forms of propulsion thus rendering 
any teleportation within the system impossible and reducing the speed of all vessels to 8.
Generates free energy, metal, and crystal for the player holding it.
中文:
大型空间站,能破坏时空结构.使大多数已知的推进装置失效,无法在星球上运输东西,且所有的部队速度都减为8.
为拥有者制造能量,金属和水晶.

英文:
Prevents all enemy ships (except scouts) from escaping from this planet through wormholes,
though enemy ships can still enter through wormholes as normal.
中文: 阻止除了侦察机以外的任何敌方部队通过虫洞离开当前星球,但它们仍然可以正常地通过虫洞进入当前星球.

英文:
Tough but not nearly-indestructible robotic courier.  Has heavier turrets than normal astro trains, and so poses much more of a threat.
More importantly, they reveal any cloaked ships that come near, and they tend to disrupt player minefields.
Build Counter-Dark-Matter Turrets to protect against them, destroy Astro Train Stations to re-route them, or attack them head-on.
If destroyed, an individual astro turret train is gone forever.
中文:
坚固但并不非不可摧毁的列车.比普通星际列车的炮火猛烈,危险更大.而且它能发现靠近的敌方隐形部队,还可以破坏敌人的空雷.
制造反暗物质塔来对付它们,摧毁星际列车站来改变它们的路线,或者直接迎头痛击它们.
一旦被摧毁将不会再产生.

英文: Causes enemy ships on the planet to have extreme trouble targeting at ranges greater than 1000.
中文: 使敌方部队在1000距离以外的命中率大大下降.

英文:
Reclaims enemy ships it kills (reclaimed ships have health = full damage inflicted by reclamator).
Reclaimed ships come back as Zombie Bots, which cannot be controlled but which will attack enemy ships 
mercilessly until they die.  Zombie bots will travel to enemy planets if no enemies present.  This golem damages itself
with zombie-creating shots, and cannot attack immobile ships that are immobile, have no attack, or are immune to reclamation.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on.
中文:
能够操控它摧毁的战舰(被操控的战舰机能为僵尸网络魔舰造成的伤害).
被操控的战舰将成为僵尸部队,无法控制,但会无畏地进攻敌人,直至死亡为止.如果当前星球上没有敌人了,僵尸部队将前往敌人的其他星球.
僵尸网络魔舰在制造僵尸部队的同时会伤害自己,且不能攻击无法移动的单位,无法进行攻击的单位和对操控免疫的单位.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援.

英文: Advanced weapon sends projectiles stripped from an iron asteroid to deal heavy damage to starships and golems.
中文: 高级武器,能从炮口发射粒子流来对星舰和魔舰造成大量损伤.

英文:
Cursed Golems continuously take passive damage, and so must constantly be repaired to survive.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on.
中文: 诅咒魔舰会不停地受到伤害,需要经常维修以保持生存.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援.

英文:
Destroy to capture a large cache of Core Zenith vessels for your own use (at some AI Progress cost).
Given the large number of ships that come online at once, be sure to have between 400k and 1 million energy available to support them.
中文:
摧毁以获得大批天顶核心部队为您所用(需要以一些人工智能进度为代价).
获得的所有部队将即刻有效,请确保拥有400,000到1,000,000的能量以满足它们的需求.

英文:
Very weak-but-fast attack, but inflicts temporary paralysis against targets it hits.
Great when combined with other ship types.
中文: 火力很低,但频率高,且能暂时瘫痪敌人的部队.适合与其它部队混合使用.

英文:
When an AI Command Station is destroyed on the alarm post's planet, or an adjacent planet,
all of the "special forces" ships in the entire galaxy will turn aggressive and attack the humans.  If the alarm post itself is
attacked and destroyed, there is only a 50% chance of it alerting the special forces ships.
中文: 当特种部队警报器所在星球或相邻星球的指挥中心被摧毁时,星系里的所有特种部队据点守卫部队将变得有进攻性,开始攻击人类.如果警报器被攻击或摧毁,有50%的机率使守卫部队发动攻击.

英文:
Relatively low health for a golem, but doesn't damage itself when firing.  Fires 50x fairly powerful 
shots at a time, dealing extreme engine damage with each volley.  Excellent for immobilizing or outright destroying large fleets.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on, and cause the AI Progress to increase as they are repaired from their broken form.
This golem is ancient and broken, and must be repaired to full health before it will become operational.
There will also need to be at least 300,000 net energy available before the golem will come online.
中文:
相对其他魔舰机能较低,但攻击时不伤害自身.同时发射50个子弹进行攻击,对引擎造成不少伤害.善于对付大群舰队.拥有100倍牵引光束.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援,当维修它们时人工智能进度将不停增加.
这艘魔舰相当残旧,当它可用之前必须完全维修它.
它还需要300,000的能量来驱动.

英文:
Very fast and nasty melee ship -- loses health over a 3 minute period, then self-destructs.
Created inside Hive Golems, when these are unloaded they are uncontrollable but will viciously attack
the enemy on the current planet. Players cannot give direct orders to the wasps.
中文:
速度极快的近战单位--3分钟内机能会缓慢地下降,直至自毁.
在蜂巢魔舰中进行制造,一旦卸载将无法控制,并将自动攻击敌人.

英文:
Destroy to capture a large cache of Mark III Zenith vessels for your own use (at some AI Progress cost).
Given the large number of ships that come online at once, be sure to have between 400k 
and 1 million energy available to support them.
中文:
D摧毁以获得大批天顶III型部队为您所用(需要以一些人工智能进度为代价).
获得的所有部队将即刻有效,请确保拥有400,000到1,000,000的能量以满足它们的需求.

英文: Advanced weapon insta-kills warheads (which explode without doing any damage or incurring any AI Progress increase).
中文: 高级武器,能一击必杀飞弹(被摧毁的飞弹既不会造成任何效果,也不会对人工智能进度有任何影响).

英文:
This nigh-indestructible Golem makes its way slowly around the galaxy, absorbing all of 
the non-core mobile military ships on planets it visits in order to power and repair itself.  
It's attack power is so high that it will insta-kill most ships, 
but it will only attack non-core ships that are both mobile and which have attack power (or are scouts).
The only way for those ships to survive is for them to flee to another planet until the devourer has moved on.
中文:
几乎坚不可摧的吞噬魔舰慢慢地周游星系,然后吸收星球上所有非核心类型的军事单位,并会以此作为能源和自我修复的材料.
它的攻击力非常高,几乎能秒杀大部分部队,但只能攻击非核心类型的单位,并且这些单位既要是可移动的,也要有攻击能力(或者是侦察机).
这些单位想活下来,只能往其他星球逃跑.

英文:
Incredibly highly armored, this golem fires 30x powerful flame waves in quick succession, 
letting it really chew through groups of enemies. Each shot also damages itself, however.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on, and cause the AI Progress to increase as they are repaired from their broken form.
This golem is ancient and broken, and must be repaired to full health before it will become operational.
There will also need to be at least 600,000 net energy available before the golem will come online.
中文:
装甲非常厚,同时发射30个火焰波,使它可以通过大群敌人.每一次攻击将伤害自身.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援,当维修它们时人工智能进度将不停增加.
这艘魔舰相当残旧,当它可用之前必须完全维修它.
它还需要600,000的能量来驱动.

英文: Fires very powerful high-range beam weapons that strike all enemy ships in a line.
中文: 发射远距离的光束同时突击一条线上的敌人.

英文:
These neutral traders are happy to trade with humans or AIs, although they charge quite a lot in
return -- and their wares are a bit different for AIs versus humans.  The trade ship travels slowly around the galaxy,
and when it has supply from your team, your entire team can use it to build very expensive and powerful ships that you 
can't directly build any other way.  The AI will use it to build such things as even new Warp Gates or Astro Train Stations --
but they only make purchases about 1% of the time when the trader exits a system belonging to them.
中文:
这些外星商人很乐意与任何付得起钱的对象打交道,尽管他们通常是漫天要价--而且他们卖给人工智能的东西与卖给人类的有一定区别.
他们周游整个星系,一旦它可以得到您的团队的补给,您的团队就可以购买他们的货物了,通常您无法以其他任何方式得到那些东西.
人工智能会购买例如新的星门或者星际列车站之类的东西--但当贸易船离开它们的星系时,它们只有1%的机率会买下货物.

英文:
Destroy to capture a sizable cache of metal and crystal 
for the player destroying it (at some AI Progress cost).

Be warned, however: around 1/5 of all nodes are actually Trojan Distribution Nodes, 
which are empty save for a malicious electronic payload that actually causes you 
to lose a sizable chunk of resources before automated recovery systems can purge 
the malicious infection.
中文:
摧毁以获得大量金属和水晶(需要以一些人工智能进度为代价).

请小心:大概1/5的分流节点实际上是木马分流节点,一旦摧毁它您反而会失去金属和水晶.

英文:
Incredibly highly armored, this golem fires 30x powerful flame waves in quick succession, 
letting it really chew through groups of enemies. Each shot also damages itself, however.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on.
中文: 装甲非常厚,同时发射30个火焰波,使它可以通过大群敌人.每一次攻击将伤害自身.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援.

英文: Astro Speed Booster Train Mark II

Enemy ships coming too close to these invisible traps will incur heavy damage. The explosions from these 
mines also effect other enemy ships that are close by. The mine is also destroyed in the process.
These are obviously useful for taking out groups of ships, but they are also useful for hitting ships that have 
Mine Avoidance -- those ships can still get caught in the blasts of area mines that are triggered by another ship.
中文:
这些隐形的陷阱将对靠近的敌方部队造成很大的伤害.区域空雷的爆炸将波及目标以外的单位.
爆炸后自身也被摧毁.
显然它们极适合对付大量敌人,但也适合对付回避空雷的部队--由其他部队引发的爆炸也会伤到它们.

英文:
Extremely fast starship with cloaking and a huge multi-targeting energy burst system.
Great for clearing out hordes of enemy ships.
中文:
快如迅雷的星舰,可隐形,且拥有巨型多目标能量爆发武器系统.
适合对付大群敌人.

英文: Fires very powerful, very long-range energy bombs, but is expensive and has a very slow reload time.
中文: 发射非常强大,攻击范围非常远的能量炸弹.但很昂贵,且需要很长的时间来重新装填弹药.

英文:
Destroying a co-processor normally increases the AI Progress by 20.
However, when you destroy the last co-processor, the AI Progress takes a massive drop of 120.
Check your Mission Summary (right side of the screen) to see how many co-processors remain; 
hitting all of them simultaneously is ideal.  
Co-Processors also interfere with supply on their planet.
中文:
摧毁一个副处理器通常会使人工智能进度上升20.
但当你全部摧毁它们时,人工智能进度反而会一下子下降120.
查看任务目标以观察还剩下多少个副处理器;最好能一口气将它们同时摧毁.
副处理器也会阻止对它所在星球的补给.

英文:
Stationary alien ship that increases the speed of all friendly ships in the current system by a large amount.
This effect is cumulative when multiple spacetime manipulators are present. Beware the minor AI Progress increase if this is destroyed.
中文: 固定的外星单位,大大增加所在星球上所有友军的移动速度.多个天顶时空操纵者的效果可以累积.一旦被摧毁人工智能进度会略微上升.

英文:
Relatively low health for a golem, but doesn't damage itself when firing.  Fires 50x fairly powerful shots at a time, 
dealing extreme engine damage with each volley.  Excellent for immobilizing or outright destroying large fleets.  Also includes 100x tractor beams.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on.
中文: 相对其他魔舰机能较低,但攻击时不伤害自身.同时发射50个子弹进行攻击,对引擎造成不少伤害.善于对付大群舰队.拥有100倍牵引光束.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援.

英文:
Must be manually assigned targets, but fires extremely, extremely powerful artillery shots over long ranges.
Is very slow, and heavily damages itself when firing, though.  Great for taking out very heavily defended targets.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on.
中文: 必须手动定位,攻击范围很远,发射极度强大的火炮攻击.移动缓慢,每一次攻击将严重伤害自身.善于对于重型防御单位.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援.

英文:
Enemy ships coming too close to these invisible traps will incur heavy damage. If the ship triggering 
the mine survives, it will also be paralyzed for 60 seconds. The mine is also destroyed in the process.
These are particularly useful for stalling out large incoming vesseles that don't have mine avoidance.
中文:
这些隐形的陷阱将对靠近的敌方部队造成很大的伤害.如果敌人未被炸死,也将瘫痪60秒.
爆炸后自身也被摧毁.
这些空雷很适合拖慢没有反空雷装置的大部队入侵.

英文:
Nearly-indestructible robotic courier.  Slightly damages nearby ships.
More importantly, they provide a massive speed boost to all AI ships in the system and reveal any cloaked ships that come near.
Destroy Astro Train Stations to re-route them.
中文:
几乎不能被摧毁的装甲先锋,能轻微地伤害附近的部队.
更重要的是,它们能极大加快星球上部队的移动速度,并能显示靠近的隐形单位.
摧毁星际列车站来改变它的移动路线.

英文:
Very little in the way of weapons, but is able to use its own health to resurrect allied mobile ships that are killed on 
the current planet. Resurrected ships are teleported back to the golem at full health at no cost beyond the health of the golem.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on.
中文: 火力并不强大,但可以使用自身的机能来使刚刚在此星球被摧毁的友军可移动部队立刻复活.被复活的单位将在魔舰所在地满状态出现,复活部队不需要付出任何资源.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援.

英文:
Very powerful and expensive frigate with sniper-style shots, that loses attack power due to interference 
when too many are on the same planet. Most efficient in groups of 2 or less.  Also includes an onboard advanced warp sensor.
中文: 非常强大而昂贵的护卫舰,攻击范围无限,但一个星球上数量太多的话火力会急剧下降.最好保证每个星球上只有至多2艘.拥有舰载高级星际跃迁探测器.

英文:
Useless remains of an exploded EMP mine.
Scrap to clear the way for replacement, or leave in place so that a Remains Rebuilder can rebuild it. 
Remains belonging to enemies can be cleared by cleanup drones.
中文:
电磁脉冲空雷爆炸后的残骸.
可以将它清理掉以布设新的空雷,或者让残骸重建机来重建它.
敌人的空雷残骸可以由清理雄蜂清理掉.

英文: Very fast starship that cloaks other ships near it, even if those ships normally do not have cloaking.
中文: 速度很快,可隐藏附近的单位,即使它们原本不是隐形的.

英文:
Useless remains of an exploded area mine.
Scrap to clear the way for replacement, or leave in place so that a Remains Rebuilder can rebuild it. 
Remains belonging to enemies can be cleared by cleanup drones.
中文:
区域空雷爆炸后的残骸.
可以将它清理掉以布设新的空雷,或者让残骸重建机来重建它.
敌人的空雷残骸可以由清理雄蜂清理掉.

英文:
Repairs damaged ships or can accelerate construction done by other ships.
Unless issued a specific command by its controller, it will automatically repair nearby allies.
Advanced prototype model that can regenerate itself as well as repairing other ships very quickly.
中文:
修复受损的部队,加快其他部队的建造速度.
除非指挥官下命令,否则它会自动修复附近的友军.
高级试验性型号,能自动回复机能,修复速度也更快.

英文:
Must be manually assigned targets, but fires extremely, extremely powerful artillery shots over long ranges.
Is very slow, and heavily damages itself when firing, though.  Great for taking out very heavily defended targets.
Golems are extremely powerful ships, and thus are very concerning to the AI. Golems cause the AI to send larger waves and 
reinforcements to the planets the golems are on, and cause the AI Progress to increase as they are repaired from their broken form.
This golem is ancient and broken, and must be repaired to full health before it will become operational.
There will also need to be at least 600,000 net energy available before the golem will come online.
中文:
必须手动定位,攻击范围很远,发射极度强大的火炮攻击.移动缓慢,每一次攻击将严重伤害自身.善于对于重型防御单位.魔舰是非常强大的单位,人工智能会非常注意它们,并会往魔舰所在星球发动更强的攻势和增援,当维修它们时人工智能进度将不停增加.
这艘魔舰相当残旧,当它可用之前必须完全维修它.
它还需要600,000的能量来驱动.
